title: Demo: Meeting Summarizer
description: A placeholder project entry for an assistant that turns club meeting notes into searchable summaries and action items.
content:
## Demo Content

This is placeholder content for testing the Projects page layout. It is not a real student submission.

Meeting Summarizer imagines a tool that converts meeting transcripts into short recaps, identifies follow-up tasks, and makes past discussions easier to search.

![Summary timeline](images/summary-timeline.svg)

## What This Demonstrates

- Text-heavy project content inside the same metadata format
- A long description that exercises the wide card truncation behavior
- Multiple SVG assets referenced through the Projects CDN path
